name: Claude Notch Usage Companion

failures: #1 mask discipline — delivered as 100x64 non-square opaque-black banner, no squircle canvas/safe-zone; likely a web-render crop of the notch sprite, not the true 1024 app-icon (unverifiable, not proven-bad)

devices: brand-colour subject-mining — creature body rendered in Claude clay to name its subject without a logo
knockout-pixel eyes as the whole face
rhymes_hint: 8-bit / pixel-art mascot icons (retro-arcade sprite) crossed terminal-hacker x playful-toy; a stylistic outlier vs the corpus's squircle/Big-Sur-flat icons — functionally a notch/menu-bar utility but shares no vocabulary with agentpeek/alcove/bartender
notes: Resolution caveat: 100x64px non-square opaque-black PNG from macapp.supply — a cropped web render, not a 1024 square (crisp source likely in GitHub claude-notch-tracker repo, not provided). Edge-hue variance (#CF7D5C/#D07E5D/#C77859/#372119) is resize anti-aliasing, NOT an intended glyph ramp — the true sprite is one flat clay hue; do not record a ramp. Cover.gif confirms brand coherence: same clay sprite in a black notch pill beside white '57%' and a mint/emerald progress ring ~#55D29D-#62D2A5 (usage-remaining accent, tinted by the desaturated-green leaf photo) — that green is product-UI only, absent from the icon. One data point toward a possible pixel-art/retro-mascot dev-utility icon cluster; needs >=2 independent icons before promotion.
